tools.name: add_crm_activity
tools.description: Log a note, call, meeting, or email against exactly one existing CRM contact, company, or deal.

owner_member_id.description: Optional workspace member ID credited for the activity.

tools.name: add_deal_note
tools.description: Add a note or comment to a CRM deal.

deal_id.description: The deal ID to add a note to

tools.name: add_pm_comment
tools.description: Add a markdown comment to a task, epic, sprint, or objective. The current entity target supplies the type and ID by default.

entity_id.description: Entity ID. Omit to use the current entity target.

entity_type.description: Entity type. Omit to use the current entity target.

tools.name: add_support_conversation_tag
tools.description: Add an existing support tag to a conversation.

tools.name: add_task_comment
tools.description: Add a markdown comment to a task. If task_id is omitted, defaults to the current task target when available.

task_id.description: Optional task ID. Omit to use the current task target when available.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Apply coordinated multi-file edits using the structured *** Begin Patch format. Read each existing file first, and use exact context lines so each hunk matches uniquely.

patch.description: Patch text in the *** Begin Patch / *** End Patch format.

tools.name: approve_epic_spec
tools.description: Mark the current epic spec document as approved and record the approved spec version on the epic.

version_id.description: Optional existing document version ID to approve. Omit to approve the current document content.

tools.name: assign_support_conversation
tools.description: Assign or unassign an existing support conversation.

clear.description: Set true to remove the current association.

tools.name: assign_task_agent
tools.description: Deprecated. Task agent assignment was removed; use workflow automation rules or start a run explicitly with an agent.

tools.name: commit_and_push
tools.description: Stage all changes, commit with the given message, and push to origin.

tools.name: crawl_url
tools.description: Crawl a small number of same-host public pages from a starting URL, prioritizing changelog, release notes, updates, announcements, docs, and roadmap paths. Use this to discover official update pages when search results are thin.

include_patterns.description: Optional URL/text substrings to include, such as changelog or release-notes.

max_characters_per_page.description: Maximum extracted text characters per page. Defaults to 6000, max 15000.

max_depth.description: Maximum same-host link depth. Defaults to 1, max 2.

max_pages.description: Maximum pages to fetch. Defaults to 8, max 20.

path_keywords.description: Optional path/link-text keywords to prioritize. Defaults to common update-page keywords.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to start crawling from.

tools.name: checkout_repositories
tools.description: Checkout one to four connected repositories. Call list_repositories first when the current target does not identify the repository.

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Create a new git branch and switch to it.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a top-level or nested collection in an existing Docs space.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new document in Helpin Docs. Accepts optional markdown content that will be auto-converted to rich text. If space_id is omitted it defaults to the workspace's only space; when several spaces exist, call list_spaces and ask the user which to use.

collection_id.description: Optional collection ID to place the document in

content.description: Optional initial document content as a markdown string. Will be auto-converted to rich text.

icon.description: Canonical icon ID. Public MCP callers should use search_icons to discover valid values, or omit this field.

space_id.description: The space ID where the document will be created. Optional — omit to use the workspace's only space; required when multiple spaces exist (use list_spaces to discover IDs).

tools.name: create_epic
tools.description: Create an epic with bounded operational fields. Agent auto-run and archive controls are excluded.

deadline.description: Optional epic deadline. Omit this field when it is not configured. When supplied, use YYYY-MM-DD.

epic_state_id.description: Optional epic workflow state ID. Omit this field when it is not configured; do not send an empty string.

owner_id.description: Optional workspace user ID. Omit this field when it is not configured; do not send an empty string.

owner_member_id.description: Optional workspace member ID. Omit this field when it is not configured; do not send an empty string.

planned_start_date.description: Optional planned start date. Omit this field when it is not configured. When supplied, use YYYY-MM-DD.

planning_repository_id.description: Optional planning repository ID. Omit this field when it is not configured; do not send an empty string.

tools.name: create_key_result
tools.description: Create a key result on the current objective target.

tools.name: create_objective
tools.description: Create an objective with bounded operational fields and complete association sets.

deadline.description: Optional objective deadline. Omit this field when it is not configured. When supplied, use YYYY-MM-DD.

owner_ids.description: Workspace user owner IDs to link.

owner_member_ids.description: Workspace member owner IDs to link.

planned_start_date.description: Optional planned start date. Omit this field when it is not configured. When supplied, use YYYY-MM-DD.

state.description: Optional initial objective state. Omit this field to use not_started.

tools.name: create_space
tools.description: Create a Docs space in the current workspace without publishing content.

tools.name: create_sprint
tools.description: Create a sprint using YYYY-MM-DD dates, an owning team, and optional labels.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a single task for a team, optionally targeting a specific workflow and stage. If workflow_id or state_id are omitted, they are resolved from the team workflow defaults.

checklist_items.description: Optional checklist items to create with the task.

assignee_id.description: Optional workspace user ID assigned to the checklist item.

due_date.description: Optional checklist item due date. Use YYYY-MM-DD.

epic_id.description: Optional epic ID to link the task to. Omit this field when no epic is configured; do not send an empty string.

label_ids.description: Optional label IDs to attach to the task

owner_member_ids.description: Optional workspace member IDs to assign as owners

sprint_id.description: Optional sprint ID to link the task to. Omit this field when no sprint is configured; do not send an empty string.

state_id.description: Optional workflow state ID override. Omit this field to use the workflow default state; do not send an empty string.

team_id.description: Team ID that owns the task

workflow_id.description: Optional workflow ID override. Omit this field to use the resolved team workflow; do not send an empty string.

tools.name: create_task_batch
tools.description: Create implementation-ready tasks for the current epic. Supports stable refs, direct assignment, and dependency refs.

proposed_tasks.description: Preferred alias for task-plan payloads. If present, it is treated the same as tasks.

tasks.description: The list of tasks to create.

tools.name: create_task_checklist_item
tools.description: Create one checklist item on an accessible task.

assignee_id.description: Optional workspace user ID assigned to the checklist item.

due_date.description: Optional checklist item due date. Use YYYY-MM-DD.

task_id.description: Optional task ID. Omit to use the current task target.

tools.name: draft_support_reply
tools.description: Draft a support reply for later human approval.

content.description: The reply content to send after approval

is_internal.description: Whether this should be saved as an internal-only note

sender_display_name.description: Optional display name for the drafted response

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Edit an existing text file by replacing exactly one matching string. Read the file first and include enough surrounding context in old_string so the match is unique.

new_string.description: Replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the matched content.

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Must match exactly once in the file, including whitespace.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root

tools.name: enrich_crm_company
tools.description: Safely enrich a CRM company with sourced public data. Company name and existing domain are protected; core fields are fill-only and agent-owned metadata is namespaced.

company_id.description: The CRM object ID to enrich.

dry_run.description: When true, returns what would be applied/skipped without writing CRM fields.

evidence_summary.description: Brief summary of the researched evidence.

fields.description: Guarded field updates to apply. Existing protected values are skipped, not overwritten.

confidence.description: Confidence from 0.0 to 1.0. Values below 0.70 are rejected.

evidence.description: Short explanation of the evidence from the source.

field.description: The guarded CRM field to enrich. Identity fields such as names are intentionally unavailable.

source_url.description: Public source URL that supports the value.

value.description: The proposed field value. Use a string for text/url fields, an integer for employee_count, and a number for annual_revenue.

tools.name: enrich_crm_contact
tools.description: Safely enrich a CRM contact with sourced public data. Names and existing email/phone are protected; core fields are fill-only and agent-owned metadata is namespaced.

contact_id.description: The CRM object ID to enrich.

dry_run.description: When true, returns what would be applied/skipped without writing CRM fields.

evidence_summary.description: Brief summary of the researched evidence.

fields.description: Guarded field updates to apply. Existing protected values are skipped, not overwritten.

confidence.description: Confidence from 0.0 to 1.0. Values below 0.70 are rejected.

evidence.description: Short explanation of the evidence from the source.

field.description: The guarded CRM field to enrich. Identity fields such as names are intentionally unavailable.

source_url.description: Public source URL that supports the value.

value.description: The proposed field value. Use a string for text/url fields, an integer for employee_count, and a number for annual_revenue.

tools.name: ensure_crm_contact_company
tools.description: Create or reuse a CRM company and associate it with a contact. Does not modify existing company identity fields.

association_label.description: Optional association label. Defaults to primary.

company_name.description: The company name to create or match.

confidence.description: Confidence from 0.0 to 1.0. Values below 0.70 are rejected.

contact_id.description: The contact ID to associate with a company. Defaults to the current CRM contact target when omitted by the runtime.

domain.description: Optional company domain to match or set on a newly-created company.

dry_run.description: When true, returns whether it would create/reuse/link without writing CRM records.

evidence.description: Short explanation of the evidence for the relationship.

source_url.description: Public source URL supporting the company/contact relationship.

tools.name: ensure_epic_spec_doc
tools.description: Create or load the canonical product spec document for the current epic and attach it to that epic. Returns the document_id and title.

tools.name: ensure_task_label
tools.description: Create or return a PM task label in the current workspace. Use this before creating tasks that must carry a stable label.

color.description: Optional hex color used when the label is first created.

description.description: Optional description used when the label is first created.

name.description: Label name to create or return, for example security.

team_id.description: Optional team scope. Omit for a shared workspace label.

tools.name: ensure_task_plan_doc
tools.description: Create or load the canonical planning document for the current task and attach it to that task. Returns the document_id and title.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch a specific public URL and return extracted title, description, readable text, and links. Use this after finding or knowing an exact changelog, release notes, blog, docs, or source URL.

include_html.description: When true, include a truncated raw HTML excerpt. Prefer false unless structure matters.

max_characters.description: Maximum extracted text characters to return. Defaults to 12000, max 30000.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to fetch directly.

tools.name: find_tasks_for_git_changes
tools.description: Resolve tasks related to PRs, branches, commits, and text references for a repository. Returns evidence and confidence for each match.

pr_numbers.description: Pull request numbers to resolve. Max 50.

repo_full_name.description: Optional repository full name like owner/repo. Defaults from the current GitHub event when omitted.

repository_id.description: Optional repository ID. Defaults from the current repository target when omitted.

texts.description: Free text to scan for task keys. Max 100.

tools.name: get_check_run_logs
tools.description: Load a GitHub check run's conclusion, output text, and annotations for diagnosing failed checks.

owner.description: Repository owner. Defaults from the current run repository when omitted.

repo.description: Repository name. Defaults from the current run repository when omitted.

tools.name: get_crm_company
tools.description: Get one CRM company in the current workspace.

tools.name: get_crm_contact
tools.description: Get one CRM contact in the current workspace.

tools.name: get_crm_deal
tools.description: Get one CRM deal in the current workspace.

tools.name: get_document_blocks
tools.description: Fetch addressable blocks for a known document. By default returns a compact paged block list; use block_ids for known blocks, anchor_block_id with around for nearby context, or include_content with a small selected set for precise edits.

anchor_block_id.description: Optional block ID to center a window around. Use when the run context already provides a focused block ID.

around.description: Optional number of sibling blocks before and after anchor_block_id to return (default 5, max 25).

block_ids.description: Optional stable block IDs to fetch. Use this when include_content is true.

document_id.description: The document ID whose blocks should be fetched

include_content.description: When true, include the full block node JSON. Limited to 20 blocks per call.

limit.description: Optional page size for compact block lists (default 40, max 100).

offset.description: Optional zero-based block offset for paging when block_ids and anchor_block_id are omitted.

tools.name: get_epic
tools.description: Get one accessible epic with description, associations, planning repository, health, and compact progress stats.

epic_id.description: Optional epic ID. Omit to use the current epic target.

tools.name: get_objective
tools.description: Get one objective with description, associations, key results, linked epics, and compact progress stats.

objective_id.description: Optional objective ID. Omit to use the current objective target.

tools.name: get_pull_request_diff
tools.description: Load the changed files and patches for a GitHub pull request. Defaults owner/repo from the current repository-targeted run when omitted.

owner.description: Repository owner. Defaults from the current run repository when omitted.

repo.description: Repository name. Defaults from the current run repository when omitted.

tools.name: get_release_context
tools.description: Load release metadata, compare commits/files against the previous published release, and resolve related tasks. Defaults from the current repository-targeted run and GitHub release event when available.

include_changed_files.description: Whether to include changed files from the release comparison.

max_commits.description: Maximum number of commits to return. Default 100, max 200.

max_files.description: Maximum number of changed files to return when include_changed_files is true. Default 200, max 500.

repo_full_name.description: Optional repository full name like owner/repo. Defaults from the current GitHub event when omitted.

repository_id.description: Optional repository ID. Defaults from the current repository target when omitted.

tag_name.description: Optional release tag name. Defaults from the current GitHub release event when omitted.

tools.name: get_sprint
tools.description: Get one accessible sprint with description, dates, derived status, team, labels, and compact progress stats.

sprint_id.description: Optional sprint ID. Omit to use the current sprint target.

tools.name: get_support_conversation
tools.description: Get one support conversation in the current workspace.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get one accessible task with its state, team, owners, labels, epic or sprint references, deadline, and blocking metadata.

task_id.description: Optional task ID. Omit to use the current task target when available.

tools.name: get_task_context
tools.description: Load compact task context with optional linked docs, document content, comments, and git links for specific task IDs.

include_document_content.description: Whether to include linked document content text. Only used when include_linked_docs is true.

include_git_links.description: Whether to include git links for each task.

include_linked_docs.description: Whether to include linked document metadata.

tools.name: repository_search
tools.description: Search repository file paths or contents. Provide query for content search, glob for path discovery, or both to restrict content search.

query.description: Optional content pattern. At least query or glob is required.

tools.name: link_crm_objects
tools.description: Create a safe association between two existing objects in the current workspace.

tools.name: link_document_to_object
tools.description: Create a Helpin Docs link between a document and another internal object.

link_context.description: Optional link context, defaults to attached

linked_object_type.description: The linked object type such as epic or task

tools.name: link_support_conversation_contact
tools.description: Link or unlink an existing CRM contact from a support conversation.

clear.description: Set true to remove the current association.

contact_id.description: Existing CRM contact ID to link.

tools.name: link_support_conversation_task
tools.description: Link or unlink an existing PM task from a support conversation.

clear.description: Set true to remove the current association.

task_id.description: Existing PM task ID to link.

tools.name: find_skills
tools.description: Discover optional skills available to this agent. Omit query for the complete compact catalog, or provide query to search metadata.

tools.name: list_buyer_signals
tools.description: List detected buyer signals from emails, meetings, and support conversations.

deal_id.description: Optional deal ID to filter signals for a specific deal

activation_only.description: Return only versioned signals that pass trust, score, dedupe, and open-task gates

limit.description: Maximum number of signals to return (default 20, max 50)

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List doc collections in the workspace, optionally filtered by space. Returns collection ID, name, slug, space ID, and parent collection ID.

space_id.description: Optional space ID to filter collections

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: Read commit history from the checked-out repository (read-only `git log`). Use for changelogs, release notes, or summarizing recent changes. Filter with branch, since/until dates (YYYY-MM-DD), path, and limit.

branch.description: Branch to read (e.g. "main"). Defaults to the checked-out branch.

path.description: Optional path filter — only commits touching this file or directory.

repository.description: Optional repository alias/full name/id when multiple repositories are checked out.

since.description: Only commits after this date, e.g. "2026-05-05" or "1 month ago".

until.description: Only commits before this date, e.g. "2026-06-05".

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List CRM contacts in the workspace, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive name, email, or job-title query. Returns name, email, and job title.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return (default 20, max 50)

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text query matched against contact name, email, or job title.

tools.name: list_conversation_messages
tools.description: List the current support conversation messages.

tools.name: list_crm_associations
tools.description: List a bounded set of associations for one existing workspace object.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 50, max 100.

object_id.description: Object ID whose associations should be listed.

tools.name: list_crm_companies
tools.description: List a bounded set of CRM companies in the current workspace.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 50, max 100.

tools.name: list_crm_pipelines
tools.description: List CRM pipelines and their ordered stages in the current workspace.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 50, max 100.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: List CRM deals in the workspace, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive name query. Returns deal name, stage, and amount.

limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return (default 20, max 50)

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text query matched against deal name.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and directories at the given path.

path.description: Directory path relative to the workspace root (empty string for root)

repository.description: Optional repository alias/full name/id when multiple repositories are checked out.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents in the workspace, optionally filtered by space.

space_id.description: Optional space ID to filter documents

tools.name: list_epic_tasks
tools.description: List all non-archived tasks linked to the current epic with name, type, status, estimate, priority, and agent assignment.

tools.name: list_epics
tools.description: List accessible epics with team, state, owner, dates, health, labels, and compact progress stats.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, max 100.

state_id.description: Optional epic workflow state ID filter.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text query matched against epic name or description.

tools.name: list_objectives
tools.description: List workspace objectives with type, state, dates, health, teams, owners, labels, linked epics, and compact stats.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, max 100.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text query matched against objective name or description.

tools.name: list_pm_labels
tools.description: List non-archived workspace and team labels that are compatible with the current actor's PM scope.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, max 100.

tools.name: list_repositories
tools.description: List the git repositories connected to this workspace (id, full name, default branch, provider). Use this to discover a repository to target or to ask the user which repo to use.

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: List the docs spaces in the workspace. Use this to discover a valid space_id before calling create_document. Returns space ID, name, slug, type, and owning team.

tools.name: list_sprint_tasks
tools.description: List compact non-archived tasks in an accessible sprint, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive text query.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, max 100.

sprint_id.description: Optional sprint ID. Omit to use the current sprint target.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text query matched against task name, description, or display ID.

tools.name: list_sprints
tools.description: List accessible sprints with dates, derived status, team, labels, and compact progress stats.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, max 100.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text query matched against sprint name or description.

tools.name: list_support_assignees
tools.description: List assignable users for one support conversation.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 50, max 100.

tools.name: list_support_conversations
tools.description: List a bounded set of support conversations with optional status, priority, inbox, and search filters.

inbox_id.description: Optional inbox or mailbox ID filter.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 50, max 100.

tools.name: list_support_inboxes
tools.description: List a bounded set of support inboxes available to the current actor.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 50, max 100.

tools.name: list_support_tags
tools.description: List a bounded set of support tags in the current workspace.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 50, max 100.

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description: Outline a source file: every function, method, type, and class declaration with its name, kind, and exact start-end line range. Use this to find a declaration, then read_symbol to read it.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root

repository.description: Optional repository alias/full name/id when multiple repositories are checked out.

tools.name: read_symbol
tools.description: Locate and read a named declaration. Omit path to search the repository; ambiguous matches return exact candidates.

include_docstring.description: Include the comment block immediately above the declaration. Defaults to true.

path.description: Optional file path relative to the workspace root.

repository.description: Optional repository alias/full name/id when multiple repositories are checked out.

symbol.description: Declaration name, e.g. a function, method, type, or class name.

tools.name: trace_symbol
tools.description: Trace where a function or method is called, what it calls, or both.

path.description: Optional file path relative to the workspace root.

repository.description: Optional repository alias/full name/id when multiple repositories are checked out.

symbol.description: Function or method name to inspect.

tools.name: list_task_checklist
tools.description: List up to 100 checklist items belonging to one accessible task.

task_id.description: Optional task ID. Omit to use the current task target; parent epic and sprint targets require an explicit task ID.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in the current workspace with optional text query, label, team, open-only, description, and comment filters.

detail_level.description: Optional response shape. Use compact for bounded task rows with short description/comment excerpts.

include_comments.description: When true, include recent task comments in the response.

include_descriptions.description: When true, include task descriptions in the response.

limit.description: Maximum tasks to return. Defaults to 50, max 100.

open_only.description: When true, only return non-completed, non-archived tasks.

owned_by_actor.description: When true, filter to tasks owned by the current workspace actor.

owner_member_ids.description: Optional workspace member IDs. When present, only tasks owned by at least one of these members are returned.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, max 100.

task_id.description: Optional task ID. Omit to use the current task target when available.

updated_after.description: Optional lower bound for task updates in YYYY-MM-DD format.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text query matched against task name, description, or display ID.

tools.name: list_team_workflows_with_stages
tools.description: List the resolved workflow and ordered stages for one team or all workspace teams. Use this to choose a valid workflow stage before creating a task.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, max 100.

team_id.description: Optional team ID. Omit to return workflow summaries for all workspace teams.

tools.name: list_workspace_members
tools.description: List active assignable workspace members with stable member and user IDs, display names, and team IDs. Email addresses are not returned.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, max 100.

tools.name: list_workspace_teams
tools.description: List workspace teams that the agent can use for team selection, task filtering, or planning context.

tools.name: move_document
tools.description: Move a document to another Docs space or collection.

tools.name: move_support_conversation
tools.description: Move an existing support conversation to another accessible inbox.

tools.name: open_pr
tools.description: Open a pull request on the remote repository.

base_branch.description: Base branch the pull request should target (defaults to the repository default branch when omitted)

tools.name: preview_json
tools.description: Publish a JSON preview into a named review slot in the interactive run drawer right pane.

content.description: Structured JSON content for the preview slot.

tools.name: preview_md
tools.description: Publish a markdown preview into a named review slot in the interactive run drawer right pane.

tools.name: publish_ai_section_candidate
tools.description: Publish the generated markdown body for the current Docs AI section as a review candidate. This stores a suggestion only; it does not mutate the document until a human approves it.

block_id.description: The AI section block ID from the run context.

content.description: Markdown body for the replacement section. Do not include a document title, provenance notes, or markdown fences.

document_id.description: The document ID from the run context.

sources.description: Optional source summaries used for the candidate.

tools.name: publish_document_change_proposal
tools.description: Submit a proposed Docs document or block change for review in Docs. This persists a Docs proposal; after success, finish without calling request_approval.

block_id.description: Required when scope is block. The stable block ID to replace.

content.description: Replacement markdown. For document scope, provide the full document. For block scope, provide replacement markdown for the focused block only.

document_id.description: The document ID from the run context.

revision.description: Required when scope is block. The current block revision from get_document_blocks.

scope.description: Whether the proposal replaces the whole document or one addressable block.

sources.description: Optional source summaries used for the proposal.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the proposed change.

tools.name: publish_prd_draft
tools.description: Publish the current PRD markdown draft for epic planner review.

tools.name: publish_preview
tools.description: Publish a structured preview panel in the interactive run drawer right pane. Use this for markdown drafts and JSON plans that should be reviewed separately from the main chat.

content.description: Panel content. Use a string for markdown previews or any JSON value for json previews.

tools.name: publish_task_plan
tools.description: Publish the current epic task plan JSON for review.

content.description: Task plan JSON object with summary and proposed_tasks. Pass structured JSON, not a stringified blob.

tools.name: publish_task_plan_doc
tools.description: Publish the current task planning document markdown for review. Always include the full markdown draft in "content"; do not send title-only payloads.

content.description: Required. The full markdown task planning document body under review, for example "# Outcome\n...".

title.description: Optional preview title. The default is Task Planning Document.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read a known document by ID. Returns metadata, a bounded plain-text excerpt, and the first page of compact addressable blocks. Use get_document_blocks with offset/limit, anchor_block_id, or block_ids for more blocks; use search_documents only to find other documents.

tools.name: read_files
tools.description: Read bounded numbered excerpts from one to four known files. The call shares an approximately 2,100-character content budget across its files, so limit_lines is only a ceiling. When has_more is true, continue exactly from next_start_line; do not restart the range or increase limit_lines. Prefer repository_search or list_symbols before reading when paths or declarations are unknown.

files.description: Files to read. Max 4 files per call.

limit_lines.description: Optional line ceiling for this file. Defaults to 60, max 240. The shared output budget may return fewer lines; follow next_start_line when has_more is true.

start_line.description: Optional 1-based line number to start reading from. Defaults to 1.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root

repository.description: Optional repository alias/full name/id when multiple repositories are checked out.

tools.name: read_skill
tools.description: Read the full instructions for one available skill selected by key or skill_id. Only skills available to this agent can be read.

skill_id.description: Workspace skill ID to read when key is ambiguous.

tools.name: remove_support_conversation_tag
tools.description: Remove a support tag from a conversation.

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Request inline approval or change feedback for a proposed artifact or plan in the interactive run drawer and wait for the human response.

phase.description: Short workflow phase label such as prd, tasks, or task_doc.

preview_panel_key.description: Optional preview panel key this approval request refers to.

title.description: User-facing title for the approval request.

tools.name: request_review_checkpoint
tools.description: Request an inline product review checkpoint in the interactive run drawer and wait for approval or change feedback.

findings.description: Optional structured review findings to persist alongside the checkpoint.

phase.description: Short product workflow phase label such as code_review or findings.

preview_panel_key.description: Optional preview panel key this checkpoint refers to.

tools.name: request_user_input
tools.description: Present structured questions in the interactive run drawer and wait for the human's answer. Use the Codex-style question payload exactly.

questions.description: Questions to present. Prefer 1-3 focused questions per request.

header.description: Optional short heading shown above the question.

isOther.description: When true, allow a freeform Other answer.

isSecret.description: When true, render the answer field as secret input.

description.description: Optional short description for the option.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run an allowlisted command in the workspace directory. Prefer program + args; shell syntax is not supported.

args.description: Command arguments as a JSON string array

command.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Plain commands only; shell operators are rejected.

program.description: The executable name (for example: go, npm, git)

tools.name: scan_gitleaks
tools.description: Run Gitleaks against the checked-out repository and return normalized secret findings with raw secret values redacted.

detail_level.description: Finding detail shape. Use index for compact triage rows, full for verbose scanner details.

exclude_paths.description: Repository-relative path prefixes to exclude from returned findings.

include_low_info.description: Whether low and informational findings may be returned.

max_findings.description: Legacy maximum findings to return after filtering. Prefer page/page_size.

package_names.description: Optional dependency package names to include.

page.description: 1-based result page after filtering and sorting. Defaults to 1.

page_size.description: Maximum findings to return on this page. Defaults to 100, max 200.

paths.description: Optional exact or prefix repository paths to include after scanning.

rule_ids.description: Optional scanner rule IDs to include.

scan_git_history.description: Run a full git-history scan. Defaults to false for scheduled scans.

scan_paths.description: Repository-relative paths to scan. Defaults to the whole repository.

summary_only.description: When true, return counts and groups without full findings.

vulnerability_ids.description: Optional CVE/GHSA/OSV vulnerability IDs to include.

tools.name: scan_semgrep
tools.description: Run Semgrep against the checked-out repository and return normalized SAST findings. Scanner output is parsed and compacted server-side.

config.description: Semgrep config path or registry config. Defaults to bundled Helpin rules.

detail_level.description: Finding detail shape. Use index for compact triage rows, full for verbose scanner details.

exclude_paths.description: Repository-relative path prefixes to exclude from returned findings.

fallback_to_auto_config.description: Fallback to Semgrep auto config when bundled rules are unavailable. Defaults to true.

include_low_info.description: Whether low and informational findings may be returned.

max_findings.description: Legacy maximum findings to return after filtering. Prefer page/page_size.

package_names.description: Optional dependency package names to include.

page.description: 1-based result page after filtering and sorting. Defaults to 1.

page_size.description: Maximum findings to return on this page. Defaults to 100, max 200.

paths.description: Optional exact or prefix repository paths to include after scanning.

rule_ids.description: Optional scanner rule IDs to include.

scan_paths.description: Repository-relative paths to scan. Defaults to the whole repository.

summary_only.description: When true, return counts and groups without full findings.

vulnerability_ids.description: Optional CVE/GHSA/OSV vulnerability IDs to include.

tools.name: scan_trivy
tools.description: Run Trivy filesystem scanning against the checked-out repository and return normalized dependency, misconfiguration, and secret findings.

detail_level.description: Finding detail shape. Use index for compact triage rows, full for verbose scanner details.

exclude_paths.description: Repository-relative path prefixes to exclude from returned findings.

include_low_info.description: Whether low and informational findings may be returned.

max_findings.description: Legacy maximum findings to return after filtering. Prefer page/page_size.

package_names.description: Optional dependency package names to include.

page.description: 1-based result page after filtering and sorting. Defaults to 1.

page_size.description: Maximum findings to return on this page. Defaults to 100, max 200.

paths.description: Optional exact or prefix repository paths to include after scanning.

rule_ids.description: Optional scanner rule IDs to include.

scan_paths.description: Repository-relative paths to scan. Defaults to the whole repository.

summary_only.description: When true, return counts and groups without full findings.

vulnerability_ids.description: Optional CVE/GHSA/OSV vulnerability IDs to include.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search documents by keyword across the workspace. Use only when you need to find other documents or the current document ID is unknown; do not use it to inspect a known current document.

tools.name: set_primary_contact_company
tools.description: Set an existing company as the primary company for an existing contact in the current workspace.

tools.name: set_task_dependencies
tools.description: Create explicit task dependency links between existing tasks.

tools.name: unlink_crm_association
tools.description: Remove one existing CRM association by ID without deleting either linked object.

tools.name: update_collection
tools.description: Update or reparent an existing Docs collection.

tools.name: update_conversation_status
tools.description: Transition the current support conversation to a different status.

tools.name: update_crm_company
tools.description: Update only the owner of an existing CRM company.

owner_member_id.description: Workspace member ID that should own the company.

tools.name: update_crm_contact
tools.description: Update only lifecycle stage, lead status, owner, or labels on an existing CRM contact.

owner_member_id.description: Workspace member ID that should own the contact.

tools.name: update_crm_deal
tools.description: Update bounded operational fields on an existing CRM deal.

owner_member_id.description: Workspace member ID that should own the deal.

stage_id.description: Existing stage ID in the selected pipeline.

tools.name: update_deal_stage
tools.description: Move a CRM deal to a different pipeline stage.

tools.name: update_document_block
tools.description: Update one addressable block in a Helpin Docs document using its current revision.

block_id.description: The stable block ID to update

revision.description: The current block revision from read_document

tools.name: update_document_metadata
tools.description: Update bounded metadata on an accessible document without changing its content, location, template, or publication state.

owner_id.description: Workspace user ID that should own the document.

tools.name: update_epic
tools.description: Update bounded operational fields on an epic. Omitted association arrays are preserved and supplied arrays replace the complete set.

deadline.description: Optional epic deadline. Use YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string to clear it.

epic_id.description: Optional epic ID. Omit to use the current epic target.

epic_state_id.description: Epic workflow state ID, or an empty string to clear it.

label_ids.description: Epic label IDs. Omit this field to preserve current associations; when supplied, it replaces the complete set; an empty array clears it.

owner_id.description: Workspace user ID, or an empty string to clear it.

owner_member_id.description: Workspace member ID, or an empty string to clear it.

planned_start_date.description: Optional planned start date. Use YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string to clear it.

planning_repository_id.description: Planning repository ID, or an empty string to clear it.

team_id.description: Owning team ID, or an empty string to clear it.

tools.name: update_epic_delivery_target
tools.description: Set or clear the repository and branch delivery target for an accessible epic.

clear_target.description: Set true to clear the configured repository and branches.

epic_id.description: Optional target ID. Omit to use the current run target.

tools.name: update_key_result
tools.description: Update bounded fields on a key result belonging to the current objective target.

tools.name: update_objective
tools.description: Update bounded objective fields. Omitted association arrays are preserved and supplied arrays replace the complete set.

deadline.description: Optional objective deadline. Use YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string to clear it.

epic_ids.description: Linked epic IDs. Omit this field to preserve current associations; when supplied, it replaces the complete set; an empty array clears it.

label_ids.description: Objective label IDs. Omit this field to preserve current associations; when supplied, it replaces the complete set; an empty array clears it.

objective_id.description: Optional objective ID. Omit to use the current objective target.

owner_ids.description: Workspace user owner IDs. Omit this field to preserve current associations; when supplied, it replaces the complete set; an empty array clears it.

owner_member_ids.description: Workspace member owner IDs. Omit this field to preserve current associations; when supplied, it replaces the complete set; an empty array clears it.

planned_start_date.description: Optional planned start date. Use YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string to clear it.

team_ids.description: Linked team IDs. Omit this field to preserve current associations; when supplied, it replaces the complete set; an empty array clears it.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Update the current execution plan for this run. Use this for short working-step checklists, not for PRDs, task plans, or canonical planning documents.

note.description: Optional short note about the current state of the plan.

plan.description: Ordered execution steps. Max 12 steps, with at most one in_progress step.

tools.name: update_space
tools.description: Update bounded metadata for an existing Docs space.

tools.name: update_sprint
tools.description: Update bounded sprint fields. Omitted label IDs preserve current labels and supplied IDs replace the complete set.

label_ids.description: Sprint label IDs. Omit this field to preserve current associations; when supplied, it replaces the complete set; an empty array clears it.

sprint_id.description: Optional sprint ID. Omit to use the current sprint target.

tools.name: update_support_conversation_subject
tools.description: Update the subject of an existing support conversation.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update bounded editable fields on an accessible task. Team, workflow, state, archive, and deletion changes are excluded.

blocker.description: Blocker description, or an empty string to clear it.

deadline.description: Optional task deadline. Use YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string to clear it.

epic_id.description: Epic ID to link, or an empty string to clear the epic.

label_ids.description: Task label IDs. Omit this field to preserve current associations; when supplied, it replaces the complete set; an empty array clears it.

owner_member_ids.description: Workspace member owner IDs. Omit this field to preserve current associations; when supplied, it replaces the complete set; an empty array clears it.

sprint_id.description: Sprint ID to link, or an empty string to clear the sprint.

task_id.description: Optional task ID. Omit to use the current task target.

tools.name: update_task_checklist_item
tools.description: Update bounded fields on one checklist item belonging to an accessible task.

assignee_id.description: Optional workspace user ID, or an empty string to clear the assignee.

due_date.description: Optional checklist item due date. Use YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string to clear it.

task_id.description: Optional parent task ID. Omit to use the current task target; parent epic and sprint targets require an explicit task ID.

tools.name: update_task_delivery_target
tools.description: Set or clear the repository and branch delivery target for an accessible task.

clear_target.description: Set true to clear the configured repository and branches.

task_id.description: Optional target ID. Omit to use the current run target.

tools.name: update_task_state
tools.description: Transition the current task to a different workflow state.

task_id.description: Optional task ID override. Defaults to the current task target.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the public web through the automatically selected configured provider. Exa is preferred when available; Brave is used when Exa is unavailable and as a fallback for compatible fast searches. Use fast mode for ordinary lookup and deep mode for neural search, extraction, or advanced filters.

freshness.description: Optional freshness hint such as pd, pw, pm, or py

tools.name: write_document_content
tools.description: Write document content to a document in Helpin Docs. Accepts either structured document JSON or a markdown string, which will be auto-converted.

content.description: The document content to save. Use either a structured document JSON object or a markdown string.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write content to a file at the given path (relative to the workspace root). Use this for new files or full rewrites after reading the current file first. Creates directories as needed.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root
